name: Brahmani Priya Darshini Parchuri
reportedText:
Dear Customer,

This is to inform you that your Army Welfare Department account has been flagged for severe security violations. Immediate action is required.

⚠️ Your account will be permanently deleted in 30 minutes if verification is not completed.

To avoid termination, confirm your identity now:

👉 http://secure-army-welfare-verify[.]net/login

You must provide:

Registered Email ID
Account Password
OTP sent to your device

❗ Failure to verify will result in:

Permanent account deactivation
Loss of all benefits and records
Blacklisting from future services

Do NOT ignore this message. This is your final notice.

Army Welfare Cyber Security Cell
note: I received an email claiming to be from the Army Welfare Department stating that my account access would be suspended due to a security issue. The message instructed me to urgently verify my identity by clicking on a link provided in the email. The link redirected me to a page that looked like an official defence login portal and asked for my personal details, including email, password, and OTP. The message created a sense of urgency and warned that failure to act immediately would result in account deactivation. I did not complete the process and reported this as a suspicious phishing attempt.
